full-page-screenshot.description: Built-in full-page screenshot methods for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, and Arc, with shortcuts, limits, and an extension option.
full-page-screenshot.heading: Full-page screenshots, browser by browser.
full-page-screenshot.lead: Each browser keeps its full-page capture in a different place. The answers below give the built-in path for each one, the table compares the limits, and each guide has the full steps and the extension option.
full-page-screenshot.answersHeading: The built-in method in each browser
full-page-screenshot.guideLink: Steps, limits, and the extension option for {browser}
full-page-screenshot.extension: OpenScreenShot adds a full-page capture to Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, and Arc. It scrolls the page, keeps a fixed header once, handles a panel that scrolls inside the page, opens the result in an editor, and exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Everything runs on your device. The capture mode reference lists every option.
